sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the CP applicability, scopes pitchValueKnown to the CP branches, requires the declared bollard and free-running pitch operands on the ship owner, uses the canonical vocabulary and units, and applies the permitted DIRECT_CALCULATION formula with tolerance scaled from the expected 0.7*free-running result. The non-CP alternative is portable and does not impose CP-only inputs. No repair is required.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the unconditional ship-level sh:minCount 1 requirement for nltl:pitchValueKnown. That applicability/input selector is required only for CP branches; as written, the non-CP alternative incorrectly requires a pitch-known boolean even though the requirement is inapplicable.
